cards.ex: Everyone chipped in to help rebuild the community center after the storm.
cards.exUz: Bo'rondan keyin jamiyat markazini qayta qurishga hamma yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishga qo'shilish, yordam berish uchun kuch yoki mablag' sarflash.

cards.ex: The lawyer offered his services pro bono to the refugee family.
cards.exUz: Advokat qochqinlar oilasiga bepul xizmat ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Bepul, jamoat uchun bepul xizmat ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: The country sent humanitarian aid to the earthquake victims.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat zilzila qurbonlariga insonparvarlik yordami yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Urush, tabiiy ofatlar natijasida jabrlanganlarga beriladigan yordam.

cards.ex: The voluntary sector plays a crucial role in supporting vulnerable people.
cards.exUz: Ko'ngilli soha zaif odamlarni qo'llab-quvvatlashda muhim rol o'ynaydi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'ngillilar asosida ishlaydigan tashkilotlar sohasi.

cards.ex: We need everyone to lend their support to this important initiative.
cards.exUz: Bu muhim tashabbusni hamma qo'llab-quvvatlashi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Birovga yoki biror ishga yordam berish, qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: The environmental campaign started as a grassroots movement.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhit kampaniyasi oddiy xalq harakati sifatida boshlandi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy odamlar tomonidan boshlangan va boshqariladigan harakat.

cards.ex: I regularly donate blood to the local hospital.
cards.exUz: Men mahalliy kasalxonaga muntazam ravishda qon topshiraman.
cards.uzDef: Birovga yordam berish uchun qon berish.

cards.ex: The school is holding a fundraising drive for new sports equipment.
cards.exUz: Maktab yangi sport anjomlari uchun mablag' yig'ish kampaniyasini o'tkazmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror maqsad uchun pul yig'ish kampaniyasi.

cards.ex: She dedicated her life to fighting for social justice.
cards.exUz: U hayotini ijtimoiy adolat uchun kurashishga bag'ishladi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatda adolat va tenglikni ta'minlash.

cards.ex: Charitable giving increased significantly after the disaster.
cards.exUz: Falokatdan keyin xayriya qilish sezilarli darajada oshdi.
cards.uzDef: Xayriya tashkilotlariga pul yoki boshqa narsalar berish.

cards.ex: The charity operates on a shoestring budget, relying on volunteers.
cards.exUz: Xayriya tashkiloti juda kam byudjet bilan ishlaydi va ko'ngillilarga tayanadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kam pul bilan ishlash.

cards.ex: The donation gave the project a real boost.
cards.exUz: Xayriya loyihani haqiqiy rag'batlantirdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga kuchli yordam berish, rag'batlantirish.

cards.ex: The church runs a community outreach program for homeless people.
cards.exUz: Cherkov uysizlar uchun jamiyat bilan aloqa dasturini olib boradi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyat bilan aloqa o'rnatish va yordam berish faoliyati.

cards.ex: The NGO provides education and healthcare in developing countries.
cards.exUz: Nodavlat tashkiloti rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlarda ta'lim va sog'liqni saqlashni ta'minlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Hukumatga tegishli bo'lmagan tashkilot.

cards.ex: Sometimes, all people need is someone to lend an ear.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan odamlarga faqat ularni tinglaydigan odam kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning muammolarini tinglash va tushunishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Restoring the old building was a labor of love for the community.
cards.exUz: Eski binoni tiklash jamiyat uchun mehnat muhabbati edi.
cards.uzDef: Pul uchun emas, balki sevgi va ishtiyoq bilan qilingan ish.

cards.ex: She is a passionate advocate for animal rights.
cards.exUz: U hayvonlar huquqlarini himoya qiluvchi ishtiyoqli inson.
cards.uzDef: Birovning huquqlari yoki maqsadlari uchun kurashmoq, himoya qilmoq.

cards.ex: The government provides social welfare programs for the unemployed.
cards.exUz: Hukumat ishsizlar uchun ijtimoiy ta'minot dasturlarini taqdim etadi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatning ijtimoiy ehtiyojlarini qondirish tizimi.

cards.ex: The museum relies on voluntary contributions from visitors.
cards.exUz: Muzey tashrif buyuruvchilarning ixtiyoriy hissalariga tayanadi.
cards.uzDef: Majburiy bo'lmagan, ixtiyoriy ravishda berilgan yordam.

cards.ex: Their efforts helped to turn the tide against poverty in the region.
cards.exUz: Ularning sa'y-harakatlari mintaqada qashshoqlikka qarshi vaziyatni o'zgartirishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yomon holatdan yaxshi holatga o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: The food bank was a lifeline for families struggling during the pandemic.
cards.exUz: Oziq-ovqat banki pandemiya davrida qiynalayotgan oilalar uchun qutqaruvchi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin ahvolda bo'lgan odamga katta yordam berish.

cards.ex: We need to roll up our sleeves and start cleaning up the park.
cards.exUz: Biz qo'llarimizni shimarib, parkni tozalashni boshlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin ishni bajarishga tayyor bo'lish.

cards.ex: She dedicated her career to public service.
cards.exUz: U butun faoliyatini davlat xizmatiga bag'ishladi.
cards.uzDef: Davlat tomonidan taqdim etiladigan xizmatlar.

cards.ex: When the team needed a leader, he stepped up to the plate.
cards.exUz: Jamoaga yetakchi kerak bo'lganda, u javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olish.

cards.ex: I believe it's important to give back to the community.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, jamiyatga qaytarish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatga yordam berish, yaxshilik qilish.

cards.ex: He is always willing to lend a helping hand to his neighbors.
cards.exUz: U doimo qo'shnilariga yordam qo'lini cho'zishga tayyor.
cards.uzDef: Birovga yordam berish, qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: I know you want to save the world, but remember, charity begins at home.
cards.exUz: Men bilaman, siz dunyoni qutqarmoqchisiz, lekin esda tuting, xayriya uyda boshlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Avval o'z oilangizga va yaqinlaringizga yordam bering.

cards.ex: The donation was helpful, but it's just a drop in the bucket compared to what's needed.
cards.exUz: Xayriya yordam berdi, lekin bu kerak bo'lgan narsaga nisbatan dengizdan tomchi xolos.
cards.uzDef: Katta muammoni hal qilish uchun juda kichik miqdordagi yordam.

cards.ex: She volunteered her services as a translator at the refugee center.
cards.exUz: U qochqinlar markazida tarjimon sifatida o'z xizmatlarini taklif qildi.
cards.uzDef: Bepul xizmat ko'rsatishga tayyor bo'lish.

cards.ex: It took a lot of effort to get the charity off the ground.
cards.exUz: Xayriya tashkilotini yo'lga qo'yish uchun ko'p kuch kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror loyihani yoki tashkilotni boshlash va rivojlantirish.
